title: Roll the Map
description: The map is rolled, tied, and slung across a shoulder,
which is the ceremony that turns a drawing into a plan.
Below the map room the world stops being represented and
starts being weather. The greenwood comes first, because
the greenwood is what the surface keeps before the stone
begins: light, leaf, and the particular confidence of a
place that has never had to think about ceilings.
Six stations lie below this one in every stratum, and they
are the same six in all of them. The arrival. The path.
The ward. The hazard. The treasure. The way on. The order
is the descent; the chapter's list is the descent's spine,
and a LINEAR chapter unlocks in exactly that order.
What changes between strata is only the light. That is the
whole point of this chapter: click between them and watch
the same six nodes wear fifteen palettes.
